name: Nihongo Master v1.0.4
changelog: v1.0.4: Authentic NES Road Fighter Stage 3 aesthetic and straight-line lane transitions. Features 3-lane to 2-lane straight diagonal taper bottlenecks, authentic warm golden sand, scalloped mint-cyan shallows, frothing white breaker crests, deep cobalt ocean with animated wave ripples, diagonal striped guardrails (/ / / /), and continuous lane markings.
